package snapshot

import (
	"context"
	"log/slog"
	"strings"

	"github.com/koopa0/yomihon/internal/schema"
	"github.com/koopa0/yomihon/internal/vault"
)

// NewParseFailureHTTPFixture is New for a folder with no rules file, over a
// parser that panics on the marked fixture in every build, the first included,
// and delegates other files to the actual parser. The child runs no
// background scanner.
func NewParseFailureHTTPFixture(ctx context.Context, source Source, log *slog.Logger) (*Store, error) {
	store := newStore(source, log, nil, schema.Ungoverned())
	original := store.parsers.note
	store.parsers.note = func(rel string, data []byte) *vault.Note {
		if strings.Contains(string(data), "PARSE_FAILURE_HTTP_POISON") {
			panic("<script>alert(1)</script> & parser token")
		}
		return original(rel, data)
	}
	if err := store.buildFirst(ctx, nil); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return store, nil
}

// RescanParseFailureHTTPFixture rebuilds the captured fixture synchronously.
func RescanParseFailureHTTPFixture(ctx context.Context, store *Store) { store.rescan(ctx) }
